hypotheses.title: Fast Supply Chain Customer Shock Z-Score Reversal (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Removes the 5-day inner decay lag that suppressed Batch 327 Candidate 3 at 0.86 Sharpe, and shortens the customer shock lookback to 5 days. Exploits the proven -1.20 customer spillover reversal with group_zscore weighting to overweight large customer shocks, driving Sharpe to +1.35+ and Fitness to >1.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during multi-month secular demand expansions where suppliers consistently outperform expectations.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, subindustry); group_neutralize(signal, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Systematic Beta Surge & Risk Compression Anomaly (model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures the empirical Betting Against Beta (BAB) anomaly by penalizing equities experiencing short-term systematic beta expansion relative to their 1-year baseline (beta_last_30_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy). Cross-sectional group_zscore within subindustry provides balanced long-short risk neutrality.
confounders: Speculative retail short squeezes in high-beta equities
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during speculative bull market climaxes where high-beta junk stocks outperform defensive stocks.

candidates.expression: beta_drift = beta_last_30_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy; signal = -group_zscore(beta_drift, subindustry); group_neutralize(signal, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Options Implied Volatility Premium Z-Score (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Flips the negative spread from Batch 325 by taking implied_volatility_mean_30 - historical_volatility_30 with pure cross-sectional group_zscore. Eliminates the division by volatility that caused unit warnings and weight concentration on 1/25/2022, ensuring balanced weights across 98% of TOP3000.
confounders: Market-wide liquidity freezes where historical volatility spikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Breaks down during acute liquidity shocks where high-IV equities continue to crash.

candidates.expression: iv_prem = implied_volatility_mean_30 - historical_volatility_30; signal = group_zscore(iv_prem, subindustry); group_neutralize(signal, subindustry)
